Name: 8 Ball
Overview: 8 BALL is a 3D casual pool game focusing on 8-ball gameplay with high quality visual appearance and wide range of customization. Player is given a stylish pool table with sizes customizable among 6 foot, 7 foot, 8 foot and 9 foot. The bed color is available in 6 colors. The game also offers yellow/red balls with options to apply national flags to them.
